evidence.excerpt: Town of Prescott Valley Uniform Drainage Policies and Standards Manual
Uniform Drainage Policies and Standards Manual
WEST Consultants, Inc. 10 10-Feb-25
The hydrology for the Town is based on the methods in the Drainage Design Manual for Yavapai County (Yavapai County, 2015).
Post-development peak discharges may not exceed pre-development peak discharges for the 2-, 10-, and 100-year storm events for the design of detention basins.
Runoff Coefficients by Storm Frequency 2- to 10-year 25-year 50-year 100-year
All new developments shall make provisions to retain the stormwater runoff from a 100-year, 2-hour duration storm.
a. 10-year: One 12-foot dry lane each direction, and flow depth shall not exceed curb height. b. 100-year: Maximum flow depth between curbs < 8 inches.

The minimum level of control for new development at which stormwater pollution prevention practices must be put in place is called the “first flush.” This consists of retaining or treating the first 0.5 inches of direct runoff from a storm event.
These green infrastructure techniques may be used to meet the first flush volume requirements if equivalent volume and performances are achieved.
The following is the preferred order of hierarchy for obtaining peak discharges and runoff volumes
peak discharges and runoff volumes shall be calculated in accordance with the procedures in this Manual.
The Rational Method, as presented herein, can be used to estimate peak discharges... for small, uniform drainage areas that are not larger than 160 acres in size.
Drainage areas that do not meet the above conditions will require the use of the unit hydrograph method implemented through the HEC-HMS Program
The design storm for synthetic unit hydrograph calculation methods shall be a 24-hour duration "frequency storm" distribution as defined by the HEC-HMS program.
One method shall be used to estimate rainfall losses: the Green and Ampt Method.
1D Hydrology – HEC-HMS (most recent version) 1D Hydraulics – HEC-RAS (most recent version), HY-8 (most recent version), and EPA-SWMM (most recent version)
2D Hydrology – HEC-RAS (most recent version). FLO-2D (most recent version, or as approved by FEMA for an FIS study) 2D Hydraulics – HEC-RAS (most recent version). FLO-2D ... XP Storm ... EPA-SWMM
Stormwater Pollution Prevention is to be addressed through the use of Best Management Practices (BMP) to the maximum extent practicable
The Town encourages the use of green infrastructure and low impact development techniques
Street design may also consider green stormwater infrastructure practices including stormwater harvesting basins, sediment traps, and curb openings.
